basic_details.short_information: There are 87 municipalities (11 Municipal Corporations, 25 Municipal Councils, and 51 Municipal Committees) under the supervision of the Urban Local Bodies Department in Haryana, entrusted with providing civic amenities to the state's urban population. To strengthen taxation and sanitation functions in these municipalities, the Directorate of Urban Local Bodies, Haryana, intends to engage Taxation Experts, Taxation Associates, and Sanitation Experts/Associates having the requisite qualification and experience, on contract basis, initially for one year and further extendable up to three years. how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications online only, at https://recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in, up to 30 September 2026. No physical application will be entertained for this engagement. The submission process is as follows:
Register: The applicant must first register by entering the required details before filling the online application form.
Sign In: After successful registration, the applicant signs in with their credentials and begins filling the application form.
Submit Application: On clicking the "Submit Application" button, a Unique Application Number will be generated.
A latest, recent passport-size colour photograph with a light background, covering 80% of the candidate's face.

A scanned copy of the applicant's signature, signed on white paper with a black ink pen; the signature portion must be cropped from the scanned document before uploading, and must be clear enough for later verification.
A self-certified copy of the detailed marksheet/certificate/degree qualification (candidates whose marksheet/degree shows GPA/CGPA must upload both sides of the document).
A self-certified copy of the experience certificate(s).
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted before the closing date will be accepted; applications sent in any other form will not be entertained and will be deemed rejected. Only applications complete in all respects will be accepted; an application submitted without a photograph or signature will be summarily rejected. It is the applicant's responsibility to ensure that all details are successfully submitted online before the closing date; the Department will not be responsible for any unforeseen circumstances. Applicants should, in their own interest, check their eligibility for the specific post before applying. If any candidate submits fake documents or certificates and this is observed at any stage of their engagement, strict legal action as per law will be initiated, which may include severing their engagement. All candidates are advised to visit the Department's website (ulbharyana.gov.in/Home/RecruitmentDetails) regularly for updates on the date of test, result, date of interview, and final selection of candidates.

content_sections.text: A total of 195 posts are proposed across three categories. As noted in the official document, the number of posts is indicative and may be increased or decreased as per requirement.

content_sections.text: Additional marks (as part of the evaluation criteria described below) will be given to candidates who have worked in Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Boards, Corporations, or Authorities.

rows.essential_qualification: MBA (with Finance as major) or Post-graduate Diploma in Management (Finance as major) or equivalent, from a recognised university or institute, minimum from among the top 50 colleges/institutions as per the latest National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF), Ministry of Education, as available on the date of advertisement of the engagement

Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Science, or Environmental Science & Engineering, from any recognised university or technical institution, minimum from among the top 50 colleges/institutions as per the latest NIRF ranking, Ministry of Education, as available on the date of advertisement of the engagement

content_sections.heading: ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts Selection Process
content_sections.text: This engagement does not involve a written examination. Selection is based on scrutiny of applications and a marks-based evaluation of qualification and experience, as follows: Applications will be scrutinised at the Directorate of Urban Local Bodies level by a committee, and candidates will be shortlisted based on merit as per the evaluation criteria above. Preference will be given to candidates holding a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), a Master's Degree, or who were toppers of their Bachelor's Degree, in the prescribed streams only. The decision of the Department will be final, and no further correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Candidates willing to work in any municipality, or at any other office under the control of the Urban Local Bodies Department in the state, will be engaged initially for one year, which may be further extended up to three years based on year-to-year satisfactory performance of the individual expert. Candidates will provide their choice of three places of posting. Either party may terminate the engagement by giving a mandatory minimum of 30 days' notice to the other. Contractual services are liable for termination at any time before the expiry of the contract period on account of poor performance, misconduct, or as per requirement, by serving 30 days' written notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notice from the Directorate of Urban Local Bodies, Haryana, Panchkula, for the contract-basis engagement of 195 posts of Taxation Experts, Taxation Associates, and Sanitation Experts/Associates in the municipalities of Haryana, dated 8 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ULB Haryana Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 195 posts: 62 Taxation Experts, 76 Taxation Associates, and 57 Sanitation Experts/Associates. This number is indicative and may be increased or decreased as per requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts posts?
faq.answer: Taxation Experts require a Chartered Accountancy qualification; Taxation Associates require an MBA/PGDM in Finance from a top-50 NIRF-ranked institute; Sanitation Experts/Associates require a Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science or Environmental Science & Engineering from a top-50 NIRF-ranked institute.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only at recruitment.ulbharyana.gov.in by 30 September 2026, following the registration, sign-in, and submission process described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the ULB Haryana selection process?
faq.answer: There is no written exam. Selection is based on scrutiny of applications by a committee and a 100-mark evaluation of qualification percentage, institute ranking/merit, and relevant experience, as detailed in the Selection Process section above, with preference given to PhD holders, Master's degree holders, or Bachelor's degree toppers in the prescribed streams.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for ULB Haryana Taxation & Sanitation Experts posts?
faq.answer: Taxation Experts receive a monthly remuneration of ₹1,00,000; Taxation Associates and Sanitation Experts/Associates each receive ₹50,000 per month.
